description_en: Retrieves the list of operators for custom rules
description_zh: 获取自定义规则操作符列表
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem describe-operators --scene-type AGGREGATE --role-type 1 --role-for 1130916744880000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeOperators

parameters.help_en:
The scenario for the operator. Valid values:

If you leave this parameter empty, the default scenario is used.

AGGREGATE: The aggregate function scenario
parameters.help_zh:
操作符使用场景类型。取值：
不传：默认场景
AGGREGATE：聚合函数场景
parameters.name: scene_type

parameters.help_en:
The view type.

0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

1: The view of all accounts that are managed by your enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the member. An administrator can use this parameter to switch to the perspective of this member
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The region of the Data Management center for threat analysis. Select a region based on your asset location. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Assets in the Chinese mainland and China (Hong Kong).

ap-southeast-1: Assets outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

Code.description_en: The status code of the request

Index.description_en: The position of the operator in the operator list
Index.description_zh: 操作符所在的操作符列表位置
Index.title_zh: 操作符所处操作符列表位置。

OperatorDescCn.description_en: The Chinese description of the operator

OperatorDescEn.description_en: The English description of the operator

OperatorName.description_en: The display name of the operator

SupportDataType.description_en: The data types that the operator supports. Multiple data types are separated by commas
SupportDataType.description_zh: 当前操作符可以支持的数据类型，以逗号分隔
SupportDataType.title_zh: 当前操作符可以支持的数据类型 以逗号分隔。

SupportTag.description_en: The scenarios that the operator supports. Multiple scenarios are separated by commas, such as aggregation (AGGREGATE). The default value is empty
SupportTag.description_zh: 操作符支持场景。多个场景以逗号分隔，如聚合（AGGREGATE）等，默认为空

items.description_en: The scenarios that the operator supports. Multiple scenarios are separated by commas, such as aggregation (AGGREGATE). The default value is empty

SupportTag.title_zh: 操作符支持场景 多个场景以逗号分隔 如聚合（AGGREGATE）等 默认为空。

true: The request was successful.

false: The request failed

true：成功
false：失败
